scope: Photographic first intersection at the 195 facade in the actual released files, including the foreground enclosure. All 194 nominal rays retained per mesh.
scope_notes: A ground jamb sample overlaps the dark boundary iron in the 2018 photograph. Two nearby samples on the rear reveal intersect modeled foreground iron a few pixels from the photographed iron. Two rear-shoulder samples are on the blurred pendant-bowl silhouette. Their nominal residuals remain visible in the reports.
The interior side openings reproduce the portions visible from the street. A rear-wall reconstruction is outside the photographic survey.
